en_title: Gears of War: E-Day Dev Confirms DDoS Attack
cn_title: 《战争机器：事变日》确认遭攻击
subtitle: 在线服务受袭
opus_summary: 开发商确认《战争机器：事变日》周末遭DDoS攻击，在线服务受影响，玩家间歇性掉线并遇到登录问题。目前游戏已恢复运行，团队仍在持续监测并缓解攻击影响。

paragraphs.en: Gears of War: E-Day suffered a DDoS attack over the weekend, developer The Coalition has said.
paragraphs.cn: 开发商The Coalition表示，《战争机器：事变日》在周末遭到了DDoS攻击。

paragraphs.en: Players suffered intermittent disconnects and login issues while trying to play the Xbox Series X and S and PC action game, which The Coalition eventually got on top of. It has now confirmed the problems were the result of a distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attack targeting online services.
paragraphs.cn: 玩家在尝试玩这款登陆XBOX Series和PC的动作游戏时，遇到了间歇性掉线和登录问题，The Coalition最终控制住了状况。工作室现已确认，这些问题源于针对在线服务的分布式拒绝服务（DDoS）攻击。

paragraphs.en: “Our teams are continuing to monitor and mitigate this activity. We’ll provide updates if there are any significant changes,” The Coalition said . “Thank you for your patience and understanding.”
paragraphs.cn: The Coalition表示：「我们的团队仍在持续监测这次攻击，并减轻其影响。如果情况出现重大变化，我们会发布最新消息。」「感谢大家的耐心与理解。」

paragraphs.en: There is a great deal of speculation online about the motivation behind hitting Gears with a DDoS attack, with some pointing to a continued online vendetta against the game for apparently being “woke.” E-Day has a “mostly positive” user review rating on Steam. Whatever the reason (there may be no overarching reason behind the DDoS attack at all), E-Day is now up and running.
paragraphs.cn: 网上有不少人猜测，对《战争机器》发动DDoS攻击的动机是什么。有人认为，这与网上持续针对该游戏的报复行为有关，而报复的缘由似乎是游戏被指「觉醒」。《战争机器：事变日》在Steam上的用户评价为「多半好评」。无论原因是什么（这次DDoS攻击或许根本没有统一的动机），《战争机器：事变日》目前已恢复运行。

paragraphs.en: Last week, Alinea Analytics' head of marketing analysis, Rhys Elliott, reported that E-Day had sold an estimated 230,000 copies in its first week in what was described as a soft start. These unofficial figures, which are not backed by data provided by Microsoft, pointed to Xbox subscription service Game Pass as cannibalizing sales.
paragraphs.cn: 上周，Alinea Analytics营销分析负责人Rhys Elliott报告称，《战争机器：事变日》首周销量估计为230,000份，被形容为开局表现疲软。这些非官方数字并无微软提供的数据佐证，但指向了XBOX订阅服务Game Pass分流游戏销量的情况。

paragraphs.en: Earlier this month, the boss of The Coalition responded to reports that staff at the studio were worried they might lose their jobs amid the ongoing cuts at Xbox, promising the next Gears game wouldn’t take as long to make.
paragraphs.cn: 本月早些时候，有报道称，随着XBOX持续裁员，The Coalition员工担心自己可能失去工作。工作室负责人回应了这些报道，并承诺下一款《战争机器》游戏的开发不会花这么长时间。

paragraphs.en: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma’s “reset” of Microsoft’s gaming business has seen nearly 2,000 people cut already this financial year, with more to come. A number of studios have left the business or are in the process of closing down. Microsoft has also reorganized its studios, bringing Halo and Sea of Thieves developer Rare under Call of Duty developer Activision, and Grounded developer Obsidian under Fallout developer Bethesda.
paragraphs.cn: XBOX首席执行官Asha Sharma对微软游戏业务的「重置」，已在本财年导致近2,000人被裁，接下来还会有更多裁员。多家工作室已脱离微软游戏业务，或正在关闭。微软还调整了旗下工作室的组织架构，将《光环》开发团队和《盗贼之海》开发商Rare划归《使命召唤》开发商Activision，并将《禁闭求生》开发商Obsidian划归《辐射》开发商贝塞斯达。

paragraphs.en: Of course, Gears of War: E-Day was selected to be an Xbox Series X and S and PC game, ditching any release for a sales-boosting PS5 version. The Coalition studio head Mike Crump recently told the BBC that success for E-Day goes behind sales, saying: "We measure things like, are we showcasing the platform? Are we pushing the hardware to its limits? Are we showcasing what the Xbox is capable of? ...Our goal basically is to be the best-looking game on the Xbox and really show the industry what's possible with our hardware.”
paragraphs.cn: 当然，《战争机器：事变日》选择只登陆XBOX Series和PC，放弃了推出PS5版来提振销量。The Coalition工作室负责人Mike Crump近日向BBC表示，衡量《战争机器：事变日》是否成功，不能只看销量。他说：「我们会衡量这些方面：我们是否展示了平台的实力？是否将硬件性能推到了极限？是否展示了XBOX的能力？……我们的目标基本上就是成为XBOX上画面最出色的游戏，真正向业界展示我们的硬件能做到什么。」
